records.canonicalEnglish:
Joe: Who the hell are you?
Shoko: Hello. It's nice to meet you.
Joe: Course we've never met. I don't know any pampered little boys and girls like you.
Shoko: What...?!
Sion: Um, we're...
Joe: I don't volunteer at the nursery, either. If you've got business here, spit it out.
Karu: Hello, Joe.
Joe: Huh? Karu? Is that you?! What's happened?
Karu: Karu came with Sion to see Joe.
Joe: Sion...? Sion?! Jido's boy? Well, would you look at that! Am I glad you came!
Joe: That little squirt's grown up enough to bring his girlfriend round to see me!
Joe: You won't remember, but you used to fall asleep in my arms, you know. So, what brings you here?
Sion: Uncle Joe, the thing is...
Joe: No need to be so formal, Sion. Just Joe'll do. Hm...? Oh, right. Maybe I shouldn't have asked. You don't have to spell it out.
Sion: No, Uncle Joe, that's not...! ...Hh...!
Narration: As Sion spoke with Joe, something inside him seemed to give way. The tension he'd been holding in broke, and before he knew it, he was crying.
Joe: Hey, hey, what's got into you? Boys aren't supposed to cry.
Sion: Dad... Dad's dead... And Mom... I don't even know where she is.
Joe: What?! Jido's dead?! And Lucia's missing?! Why the hell didn't you say so sooner?!
Shoko: I'm Shoko, Mamon's daughter. My father... killed Sion's father...
Joe: ...! Don't talk nonsense, little lady.
Joe: Mamon, Jido and me were the best of friends long before you were born.
Sion: ...But I saw it too.
Joe: Sion... Not you too...
Joe: No. Even if it's true, something must have forced his hand. I'm sure of it!
Narration: With both children sobbing, Joe was at a loss.
Joe: Come on, crying won't get us anywhere. Let's head into Hamack and see if we can find out where Lucia and Mamon went.
Sion: Before that... When Dad and the others died, I panicked. I left their bodies there...
Joe: Ah... Yeah... But it's too late for that. You know those bugs will eat anything.
Shoko: But...
Joe: There's nothing we can do for the dead. Finding Lucia comes first. Right! Let's get moving.
